Queues player error logs in localStorage when CMS is temporarily unreachable and flushes them later in batch
Keeps snapshotFetch=0 default and trusts /api/player-state payload playlists
Adds safe version.json build check for automatic reload after Player deployment
Does NOT add 6-hour media quarantine; existing session-skip behavior remains only for the current session
notes: Content sync field-log build. Works with CMS v1.8.3 and APP v9.2 without APP changes.
